name: Tesseract State Target
description: Build an exact native Tesseract StateTarget while preserving absent velocity, acceleration, and time fields.

inputParameters.name: positions
inputParameters.description: Ordered joint positions in native joint units: radians for revolute joints and metres for prismatic joints.

inputParameters.name: joint_names
inputParameters.description: Optional exact joint-name order. When omitted, Tesseract Motion Program supplies the selected native group's order.

inputParameters.name: velocities
inputParameters.description: Optional ordered native joint velocities. Unconnected remains absent, never zero-filled.

inputParameters.name: accelerations
inputParameters.description: Optional ordered native joint accelerations. Unconnected remains absent, never zero-filled.

inputParameters.name: time
inputParameters.description: Optional finite non-negative time from program start in seconds.

inputParameters.name: move_type
inputParameters.description: Exact native move type: FREESPACE, LINEAR, or CIRCULAR. Defaults to FREESPACE.

inputParameters.name: profile
inputParameters.description: Exact non-empty Tesseract motion-profile name. Defaults to DEFAULT.

outputParameters.name: target
outputParameters.description: Exact native tesseract_robotics.planning.StateTarget retaining every supplied field and absence.
